title: kbgit.py sync reads the remote ref after a push that timed out before it reports the push failed
goal: When git push does not finish within KB_GIT_NETWORK_TIMEOUT, kbgit.py sync fetches origin and reports pushed: yes when the remote ref holds the local commits, so the SP-foopqq2x claim push that landed is not reported as failed with exit 1

run:
import sys, os, subprocess, tempfile, types, io, contextlib
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import kg_sync as S
def g(*a, cwd=None):
    return subprocess.run(['git', *a], cwd=cwd, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.strip()
def scenario(lands):
    t = tempfile.mkdtemp()
    bare = os.path.join(t, 'o.git'); g('init', '-q', '--bare', '-b', 'main', bare)
    c = os.path.join(t, 'c'); g('clone', '-q', bare, c)
    g('config', 'user.email', 'a@b.c', cwd=c); g('config', 'user.name', 'n', cwd=c)
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(c, 'kb/public'))
    f = os.path.join(c, 'kb/public/a.md')
    open(f, 'w').write('1\n'); g('add', '-A', cwd=c); g('commit', '-q', '-m', 'first', cwd=c); g('push', '-q', 'origin', 'HEAD:main', cwd=c)
    open(f, 'w').write('2\n'); g('add', '-A', cwd=c); g('commit', '-q', '-m', 'second', cwd=c)
    S.KB = c
    real = S.gitx_net
    def slow(*args, env=None):
        if args[0] == 'push':
            if lands:
                subprocess.run(['git', *args], cwd=c, capture_output=True, text=True)
            return 124, 'kbgit.py sync: git push did not finish within 1 s (KB_GIT_NETWORK_TIMEOUT)'
        return real(*args, env=env)
    S.gitx_net = slow
    S.tool = lambda *a, **k: (0, '')
    S.gate = lambda *a, **k: True
    S.refresh_trailers = lambda *a, **k: True
    a = types.SimpleNamespace(remote='origin', branch='main', push=True, dry_run=False, session=None)
    r = S.new_report(True)
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
        code = S.sync_once(a, r, None)
    return code, r['pushed']
c1, p1 = scenario(False)
c2, p2 = scenario(True)
print('timed out, not landed:', c1, p1, '| timed out, landed:', c2, p2)
sys.exit(0 if c1 == 1 and p1.startswith('no') and c2 == 0 and p2.startswith('yes') else 1)

gates.question: Which pushes does the read-back after a timed-out push cover?
options: the push to main only, read back at its ref
every push sync makes, each read back at the ref it pushed
gates.recommendation: the push to main only, read back at its ref
gates.answer: the push to main only, read back at its ref
